scope: Cadence archived web/backend/content/rootconfig/deploy/scripts/docs/tests/public; top-level mobile,desktop,store excluded for other agent.
inspection_method: Read every tracked scoped file as bytes; UTF8-decode and lexically classify every text file. Manually inspect meaningful architecture, routes, puremodels, auth/billing/OAuth/MCP,pairing, audio/ML, operations, content and tests. Binarymedia hashed/classified only.

features.title: Guided pronunciation modules and lessons

features.title: Scripted speaking conversations and target/free AI coach
features.source_status: Archived implementation and tests inspected statically; not installed, executed, or integrated into Eng Teacher.
features.summary: Conversation modules define scenario, focus, ordered coach turns and expected responses; UI explicitly sequences intro/coach/recording/assessment/result/done. AI coach generates localQwen or cloudGemini turns with target and freedom modes and saved histories.

Native Hindi/Bengali teaching is not validated or explicit default capability.
Coach requirements include unpinned Transformers Git HEAD.

features.title: Just Speak transcript-driven coaching
features.source_status: Archived implementation and tests inspected statically; not installed, executed, or integrated into Eng Teacher.
features.summary: Browser records a short sample, /api/just-speak transcribes it, then optional Gemini feedback builds a summary, improvement list and spoken drill; browser retains transcript/feedback history.
features.overlap_with_active_eng_teacher: Active app supplies structured interview correction; no distinct free-speech review page.
features.future_opportunity: Could inform a separate free-speaking reflection mode after privacy and educational review.
risks: Route sends only recognized text to Gemini, with overallScore:null and no acoustic features; prompt still asks for pronunciation improvements. This is not evidence-based pronunciation assessment.
History persists locally, unlike active app in-memory recap; consent/retention rules differ.

features.title: Audio-based phoneme recognition and heuristic feedback
features.source_status: Archived implementation and tests inspected statically; not installed, executed, or integrated into Eng Teacher.
features.summary: FastAPI /assess reads capped uploads and target text; decodes/resamples audio, runs Wav2Vec2 CTC phoneme model and phonemizer target, aligns sequences and word windows, returns phoneme/highlight/overall feedback.
features.overlap_with_active_eng_teacher: Active Eng Teacher intentionally has no pronunciation grade.
features.future_opportunity: Candidate separate experimental assessor; never substitute transcript similarity for acoustic assessment.
risks: Overall score is edit-distance-derived; per-phoneme match/mismatch uses fixed96/48 values. These are heuristics, not calibrated accuracy probabilities or human-grade evidence.
Real accent/noise/language calibration absent from inspected tests.
FastAPI logs target text, request filenames and diagnostic errors.
Model/weights/assets require individual rights review.
2MiB/30second upload design suits short drills, not streaming ten-minute lessons.
